description: PATCH /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments/:id — updates the name and/or branding (displayName, theme); at least one must be given and only the given fields change. Renaming does not move the internal hostname; chainId and status cannot be changed here. Returns the updated detail. Requires a fresh JWT.

theme.description: Branding theme published to the tenant site. The logo is set with yield_deployments_logo_upload.
